text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Over the next several days following her
race, I try approaching
Narita Brian several
times. However...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: There's nothing to talk about.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Scram.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, it's that trainer.
Pretty gutsy to come
again.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
That's the most persistent one we've seen
yet, huh? I'm sure Brian will
say no, just
like at the tryouts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've heard about Brian's tryout race. The
tryouts are supposed to be
where racers
attempt to get scouted, but she refused
every offer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And when talk turns to making her debut, she abruptly leaves without another word. Maybe that's what she has a problem with...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Another few days later, I hear that Narita
Brian's going to race again,
so I hurry over
to see it.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hraaagh!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hishiama's really fired up today! Like,
we're talking a whole 'nother
level!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Well, she's the one who suggested they
race, so she can't afford to
lo— Whoa!
Hishiama's making her move!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna... crush you! Wraaaaagh!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Hup!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Wha?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Gah... Damn it! Aaaaagh!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant... Ugh!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hold it!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Just where do ya think you're goin'? Our
battle isn't over. I challenged
you to a
one-on-one, best outta three.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
And I ain't losin' again! So get ready for
the next—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
The outcome's already decided. You know
full well that if we race
again, the results'll
be the same.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to see anyone's fire go out
anymore, much less extinguish
it myself.
I'm... sick of it.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Damn it... I know, okay? I know I can't
beat you right now!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
But... that doesn't mean I'm a quitter who
gives up after one measly defeat. Don't
you dare go 'round assumin' you know
what everyone's
like!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...You again.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Didn't I tell you to scram?
Don't let me see
you again.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Fine,
I'll say it. Racers like that might put
on a tough front, but once
their spirit's
burned out, it ain't coming back.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I've seen it a hundred times. There's no
point in me racing them.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: It wouldn't satisfy anyone.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
(It's always been like this.
Ever since back
then.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: (When... I first felt this hunger.)

text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hurry up, Brian!

text_block_list.name: Young Brian
text_block_list.text: Coming!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
(She was always ahead of me. I felt like a
wild animal on the chase,
but she never let
me pass her. It was the most fun I've ever
had.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
(I'd run and run... I'd keep running and
chasing after her... But no
matter how
satisfying it felt, I only wanted more.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: (And then it happened.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Crash!

text_block_list.name: Young Brian
text_block_list.text: Sis? Sis, wake up. Sis... Sis!

text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Sorry, Brian.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wee woo, wee woo!
